services.name: Camp
services.desc: The City of Steinbach is pleased to offer safe and active summer activities for children and youth in our community. The City of Steinbach Summer Recreation Camps have been designed to provide safe and creative summer activities to campers. Our camps have a fun and energetic atmosphere and offer participants a variety of recreational activities that promote movement and fitness. With seven different camp weeks to choose from, you’re sure to find an exciting option for your child. Come join our safe summer fun! Drop Off Time: 9:00 a.m. Pick Up Time: 3:30 p.m. Locations will be outlined on your official camp schedule once registered. Locations are subject to change. Locations: Southeast Event
